# hpe_opsramp_permission_set (Resource)

Manages an OpsRamp Permission Set resource. Permission sets define specific permissions that can be assigned to roles.




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the permission set.

### Optional

- `client` (String) The client (tenant) UUID where this permission set should be created. If not specified, uses the provider's tenant.
- `description` (String) The description of the permission set.
- `permissions` (Attributes Set) Set of permissions in the set. Order does not matter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

### Read-Only

- `unique_id` (String) The unique identifier of the permission set.

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Optional:

- `name` (String) The name of the permission.
- `type` (String) The Type of the permission.
